lesson.name: Learn The Benoni Defense
lesson.description: Learn the key plans and tactical ideas for both sides in the Benoni Defense.

{White's d5-d6 advance was premature. How should Black prepare to win the
overextended pawn?} 4... Ne4 {[%wrong There's a better attacking option. Try
again and look for a good way to attack the d6-pawn.] [%hint Centralize a
piece and attack d6.]} (4... Qb6 $5 {This is a good choice, but it's even
stronger to attack d6 with a knight. How can you do that?}) (4... Qa5+ $2 5.
Nc3 {White develops and keeps the d6-pawn. Try again and look for a good move
to target d6.}) (4... g6 $2 5. Nc3 {It's better to target the d6-pawn with
another piece. How should you do it?}) 5. Bf4 {Great start! How should you
take advantage of the exposed bishop on f4?} Qf6 {[%wrong There's a better
attacking option. Try again and look for the best move to target the f4-bishop.
] [%hint Develop to fork f4 and b2.]} (5... Qa5+ $5 {This is a good move, but
there's an even better square for the queen. Try to find it.}) (5... Qb6 $5 6.
Nc3 {Black is doing well, but there's a better square for the queen. Try to
find it.}) (5... Nc6 $5 {This is a good move, but it's best to develop and
attack the f4-bishop. How should you do it?}) (5... Qh4 $2 6. g3 {The queen
must retreat. Try again and look for a better queen move.}) (5... g5 $2 6. Be5
{Black is doing well, but it's stronger to develop a piece to attack the
bishop. How should you do it?}) 6. Qc1 {Good choice! How should Black win a
pawn?} Bxd6 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and look for the best
capture.] [%hint Develop a piece and capture a pawn.] Good work! Black has an
extra pawn and a great position.} (6... Nxf2 $5 {This is a good option, but
it's simpler to capture a pawn while you develop a piece. How should you do it?
}) (6... Nxd6 $2 7. Nc3 {Black is doing well, but it's stronger to develop
while capturing a pawn. How should you do it?}) *

{Black's Nd7 was premature. How should White take advantage with an unusual
way to develop the kingside?} 8. Nh3 {[%wrong There's a better developing move.
Try to find a good square for your g1-knight.] [%hint Develop your g1-knight
and prepare to bring it to f2.]} (8. a4 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's even
better to develop the g1-knight. Where should it go?}) (8. Be2 $5 {This is
reasonable, but it's even better to develop the g1-knight. Where should it go?}
) (8. Nge2 $2 Bg7 {This is a normal-looking move, but because the c8 bishop is
blocked, there's a better way to develop. Try to find it.}) (8. Bb5 $2 a6 {
The bishop must retreat again. Try again and look for a way to develop a
knight.}) 8... Bg7 {Great start! Where should that knight head next?} 9. Nf2 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find the perfect square for your
kingside knight.] [%hint Fill the hole on f2 with a knight.] Great move! The
knight on f2 is ideally placed to control the center and defend your king.
White has good chances of obtaining an opening edge.} (9. Bg5 $5 {This is OK, but
it's best to continue to improve your h3-knight. Where should it head next?}) (
9. Be2 $5 {This is OK, but it's best to continue to improve your h3-knight.
Where should it head next?}) (9. a4 $5 {This is OK, but it's best to continue
to improve your h3-knight. Where should it head next?}) (9. Ng5 $2 O-O $2 {
It's better to retreat the knight to protect your kingside. Where should it go?
}) (9. Nf4 $2 O-O {It's better to retreat the knight to protect your kingside.
Where should it go?}) (9. Ng1 $2 O-O {There's a better kingside square for
this knight. Try to find it.}) *

{Black has sacrificed a pawn on h6. How should you show that it's fully
justified?} 11... Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and check
the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight to gain a tempo on the
white queen and clear the d8-h4 diagonal.]} (11... Bxh6 $2 12. Qxh6 {White
keeps an extra pawn and a good position. Try again and look for a stronger
capture.}) (11... Nxd5 $2 12. Bxg7 {White will emerge with an extra piece. Try
again and look for a better knight sacrifice.}) (11... Re8 $2 12. Bxg7 {
White has an extra pawn and a good position. Try again and look for a strong
forcing move.}) 12. Nxe4 {Awesome move! How should you win back the sacrificed
piece?} Qh4+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong
fork. ] [%hint Fork the white king and the h6-bishop.]} (12... Bxh6 $2 13. Qxh6
{White keeps an extra piece and Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a
better attacking move.}) 13. g3 {Good idea! What's next?} Qxh6 {[%wrong White
is winning. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Save your queen and
capture a piece.] Nice job! White can capture on d6 next, but the powerful
dark square bishop and the safer king give Black a good game.} (13... Bxh6 $2
14. gxh4 {White will emerge with an extra piece. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) *

{White's f4 push was ill-advised. How should Black save the e5-knight?} 12...
Neg4 {[%wrong White wins material. Try again and look for a way to save your
e5-knight.] [%hint Save your knight and threaten a fork on e3.]} (12... Ned7 $2
13. Bf3 {White's space advantage will be hard to defend against. Try again and
look for a better knight move.}) 13. Bxg4 {Good start! How should you
recapture?} Nxg4 {[%wrong White has too much material. Try again and look for
a good capture.] [%hint Recapture and free your g7-bishop.] Good work! You can
continue the game in the next challenge.} (13... Bxg4 $2 14. Qc2 {This is
playable, but there's a stronger capture. Try to find it.}) *

{How should Black break apart the big white center?} 14... f5 {[%wrong There's
a better option. Try again and look for a good way to attack the white center.]
[%hint Trade off the e4-pawn with your f-pawn.] Well played! White can't
maintain the big center and the exposed white king will soon cause difficulties.} (
14... Bxc3 $5 {This is playable, but it's risky to trade off your strong
dark-squared bishop. See if you can find a stronger move to attack the white
center.}) (14... c4 $5 {This is OK, but it's stronger to immediately target
the white center. How should you do it?}) (14... Bd4+ $2 15. Nxd4 {White wins
a pawn. Try again and look for a way to attack the white pawn center.}) (14...
Qb6 $2 15. a5 {The queen must move again. Try again and look for a way to
attack the white center.}) *

{Black has sacrificed a piece for a winning attack. How should you target the
exposed white king?} 14... Bd4+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and
look for a way to take advantage of the exposed white king.] [%hint Centralize
a piece with check.]} (14... Bxg4 $5 {This is a strong capture, but let's aim
for a good check. Try to find it.}) (14... Bxc3 $2 15. bxc3 {White keeps an
extra piece. Try again and look for a better forcing option.}) (14... Nxc3 $2
15. bxc3 {White will keep an extra piece. Try again and look for a stronger
forcing move.}) 15. Be3 {Good idea! How should Black win material?} Nxc3 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to win material.] 
[%hint Capture a piece and make a discovered attack against e3.]} (15... Bxg4
$5 {This is a good choice, but let's try another capture. Which is the other
good option?}) (15... Bxc3 $2 16. Bxc8 {White will keep an extra piece. Try
again and look for a stronger capture.}) (15... Bxe3+ $2 16. Nxe3 {Black is
only slightly better. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 16. bxc3 {
Nice move! What should you capture next?} Bxe3+ {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece with check.]} (
16... Bxg4 $5 {This is a good move, but let's find an even more forcing
capture.}) 17. Nxe3 {Well done! How should you win back the piece?} Rxe3 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture an undefended piece.] Great work! Black has an extra pawn and should
eventually win the game.} (17... Bxg4 $2 18. Nxg4 {White keeps an extra piece.
Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) *

{How can Black win material?} 15... Bxg4 {[%wrong There's a stronger attacking
move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece and decoy
a defender off of White's back rank.]} (15... Nf2+ $2 16. Rxf2 {White can meet
Bxg4 with Qd2 and keep an extra piece. Try again and look for a stronger
attacking move.}) (15... Bxc3 $2 16. Bxc8 {White keeps a material edge and
Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (15... Nxc3
$2 16. bxc3 {White keeps a material edge and Black is in trouble. Try again
and look for a stronger capture.}) (15... Qh4 $2 16. Nxe4 {White wins material
and Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) 16. Qxg4 {
Good start! How can Black win substantial material or checkmate?} Nf2+ {
[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for a winning fork.
] [%hint Fork White's king and queen. Note that the rook on f1 is defending
against back rank mate.]} (16... Bxc3 $2 17. Qf3 {Black is doing well, but
there's a much better move. Try again and look for a way to win the white
queen or checkmate.}) 17. Rxf2 {Great job! How can you force checkmate?} Re1+ {
[%wrong There's a way to force checkmate, but that's not it. Look at your
attacking options and try again.] [%hint Look for a check to force mate.]} 18.
Rf1 {Almost there! What's next?} Rxf1# {[%wrong There's a checkmate, but
that's not it. Look for a shot at the white king.] [%hint Look for a check. Is
it mate?] Well done!} *

{How did GM Korobov maneuver his d2-knight to take advantage of weaknesses on
the black kingside?} 13. Nf1 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a
good move with your d2-knight.] [%hint Retreat the d2-knight so that it can
soon reach the useful g3-square.]} (13. h3 $2 a6 {Black has a comfortable
position. Try again and look for a good move with the d2-knight.}) (13. Nc4 $2
Nxc4 {It's better for the knight to head toward the kingside. Try to find a
stronger square for it.}) (13. Nf3 $2 Nxf3+ {There's no need to trade knights.
Try to find a better kingside path for this knight.}) (13. Ndb1 $2 Nfd7 {
It's better for the knight to head toward the kingside. Try to find a stronger
square for it.}) (13. Nb3 $6 h6 {It's better for the knight to head toward the
kingside. Try to find a stronger square for it.}) 13... h6 {Great start! Where
should the knight head next?} 14. Ng3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find a good square for your f1-knight.] [%hint Control f5 and h5 with your
knight.] Well played! The knight dominates weak squares in the black kingside
and White went on to win in Korobov - Simacek 2014.} (14. Ne3 $2 a6 {The
knight on e3 blocks the c1-bishop. Try to find a better square for this piece.}
) (14. Bd2 $5 {This is reasonable, but GM Korobov preferred to continue to
maneuver the f1-knight. Where should it head next?}) (14. a5 $5 {This is
reasonable, but GM Korobov preferred to continue to maneuver the f1-knight.
Where should it head next?}) (14. Qc2 $5 {This is reasonable, but GM Korobov
preferred to continue to maneuver the f1-knight. Where should it head next?}) (
14. Nd2 $2 Ng6 {There's a better square for this knight. Try to find it.}) *

{How should Black escape the check?} 8... Nfd7 {[%wrong White wins material.
Try again and look for a good way to block the check.] [%hint Block the check
and don't allow White's e4-e5 advance to attack a knight.] Great move! Now,
e4-e5 doesn't come with a threat and Black may soon check on h4 with the queen.
} (8... Nbd7 $2 9. e5 {White has a dangerous attack that we can examine in the
next challenge. Try to find a better way out of check.}) (8... Bd7 $2 9. e5 {
White has a dangerous attack. Try to find the most popular option to block the
check.}) (8... Kf8 $2 9. e5 {By giving up the right to castle, Black hands
White a dangerous attack. Try to find a good way to block the check.}) (8...
Ke7 $2 9. e5 {By giving up the right to castle, Black hands White a dangerous
attack. Try to find a good way to block the check.}) *

{How should White take advantage of the pin on the d7-knight?} 9. e5 {[%wrong

[%hint Attack the f6-knight with a pawn.]} (9. Nf3 $2 O-O {Black's king
escapes danger and the position is about even. Try again and look for a strong
threat.}) (9. Bxd7+ $2 Bxd7 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a
strong threat.}) 9... dxe5 {Great start! How should you continue the attack?}
10. fxe5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.
] [%hint Recapture in the center.]} Nh5 {Well played! How should White win
material?} 11. e6 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a
good way to attack the pinned knight.] [%hint Advance a pawn to attack the
pinned knight.] Nice work! The position is complicated, but White is doing
well with best play as there's no way to save the knight on d7.} (11. Nf3 $5 {
